title: REQ · Background layers and furniture exist as separate registered assets
summary: Wall, floor, window background, lighting, chair and wardrobe added as separate manifest assets
description: Context: only a flattened bedroom-room.svg background and bed, bookshelf and desk furniture exist. Desired behavior: separate wall, floor, window-view and lighting layers, plus chair and wardrobe furniture files, each in the manifest with exact dimensions. Expected result: layers can be replaced individually. Why: layer-based architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the manifest, when read, then ids background:wall, background:floor, background:window-view, background:lighting, furniture:chair and furniture:wardrobe exist
Given each new SVG, when its width and height are read, then they equal the manifest dimensions
Given the new SVGs, when scanned, then they contain more than one fill color and are not a single gray rect
technical_constraints: 320x180 logical room size for full-room layers
